description.p: This is the GNU C++ compiler, a fairly portable optimizing compiler for C++.

maintainer-scripts.postinst:
BIN="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
# Another version may have been there first. What has no system type in the # name is not for the compiler of the tools folder. for PROG in g++; do if [ ! -e "$BIN/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG" ]; then ln -sf "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG-16" "$BIN/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG" fi if [ -e "$BIN/$PROG-16" ] && [ ! -e "$BIN/$PROG" ]; then ln -sf "$PROG-16" "$BIN/$PROG" fi done if [ ! -e "$BIN/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-c++" ]; then ln -sf "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-g++-16" "$BIN/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-c++" fi if [ -e "$BIN/g++-16" ] && [ ! -e "$BIN/c++" ]; then ln -sf "g++-16" "$BIN/c++" fi
maintainer-scripts.postrm:
BIN="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
for PROG in g++ c++; do for LINK in "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG" "$PROG"; do if [ ! -e "$BIN/$LINK" ]; then rm -f "$BIN/$LINK" fi done done
